traits.name: Solo Turns
traits.text: The Grand Meddle can take five full turns each round. It can't take turns consecutively.

traits.name: Sacrifice the Squealer (Legendary Resistance)
traits.text: When the Grand Meddle would be affected by a potency effect or an effect that can be ended by a saving throw, it can sacrifice one member of the meddle to ignore that effect completely. The Grand Meddle takes 30 damage that can't be reduced in any way. It can't sacrifice its final member.

traits.name: Lockdown
traits.text: Any enemy who shifts adjacent to the Grand Meddle has that shift end. Additionally, any enemy adjacent to the Grand Meddle can't shift.

traits.name: Gymratstics
traits.text: The Grand Meddle gains an edge on strikes against larger creatures.

traits.name: Musical Suggestion
traits.text: Once per round, at the end of one of the Grand Meddle's turns, it can slide one adjacent creature up to 2 squares, ignoring stability.

maneuver.name: Over Here, Thanks
maneuver.effect: The Grand Meddle slides the target up to 3 squares, then can shift into any square the target left.

action.name: En Garde
action.effect: The Grand Meddle darts between its targets in a flashing storm of tiny blades.
action.additional_effect: The Grand Meddle shifts up to 2 squares after striking the first target, then can shift 1 square after striking the second target.

action.name: Lockjaw
action.effect: Several radenwights pile onto the target and sink their teeth in.
action.additional_effect: A target grabbed this way takes 2 damage at the start of each round. The Grand Meddle can have only one creature grabbed this way at a time.

villain_action.name: Villain Action 1 — The Meddle Begins
villain_action.effect: The Grand Meddle shifts up to its speed, then takes the Defend action.

villain_action.name: Villain Action 2 — Cacophony
villain_action.effect: The entire meddle erupts into a piercing musical assault.

tier1.tier_effect: slide 1; the Grand Meddle can shift 1 square

tier2.tier_effect: slide 3; the Grand Meddle can shift up to 3 squares

tier3.tier_effect: slide 5; the Grand Meddle can shift up to 5 squares

villain_action.additional_effect: The Grand Meddle can shift only once for each power roll, regardless of the number of targets.

villain_action.name: Villain Action 3 — Rondo of Rats
villain_action.targets: Each previously defeated or sacrificed member of the meddle in the area
villain_action.effect: Each target briefly rises, makes a free strike against an adjacent enemy, then falls dead again. No enemy can be targeted by more than two of these free strikes.

malice.name: Trouser Cut
malice.effect: The Grand Meddle makes an embarrassing low strike against the target.

tier2.tier_effect: push 3; taunted until the end of the target's turn

tier3.tier_effect: push 5; taunted until the end of the target's turn

malice.additional_effect: If the target is wearing clothing covering the lower half of their body, they must use a maneuver once to pull that clothing up before they can move.

malice.name: Rat Race
malice.targets: Self and each adjacent enemy at the end of the shift
malice.effect: The Grand Meddle shifts up to its speed. At the end of the shift, it can make one melee free strike against each adjacent enemy.

malice.name: Rally the Rodents
malice.targets: Each enemy in the area when the wall disperses
malice.effect: The Grand Meddle uses music to coordinate living rats, forming a 1 × 10 wall of rats scurrying atop one another in unoccupied spaces anywhere on the encounter map. The wall doesn't block line of effect for the Grand Meddle or its allies, but it does for other creatures. Each square of the wall has 10 Stamina. If the Grand Meddle dies while the wall is still standing, the rats let out a hideous screech as they disperse. Each enemy on the encounter map makes an Intuition test. Tier 1: 7 sonic damage, and the target can't take a respite activity during their next respite. Tier 2: 5 sonic damage. Tier 3: No effect.
